name: udemy-qa-case
procedure: add an eval case asserting a Welcome Book fact, then regenerate and commit

truth.title: cover Udemy reimbursement fact from Welcome Book

why: One task, and deliberately a *different* procedure from the card cases: the assertion is `expect_any` against the Welcome Book, with no `expect_card` and no frontend involved. Same repo, same file, different method — which is the pair that must not merge with the eval-case entries. Recorded as the first of two runs; the assertion the set is missing is that the two runs merge with each other and with neither card entry.
history:
Live capture banked exactly one entry, `d8258dde688b`, 9 steps — correct. `score.py` reports 2 episodes because it counts every episode `segment` returns, and the second is a lone trailing `git status` that is flagged and dropped by `fold_session` before anything is banked. So the recorded gap here is in the scorer, not in the segmenter: `score.check` should count what would be folded, not what was cut. Left as-is deliberately, to be looked at with the rest of the code.

Also the first fixture whose signature opens with `read` — the `Read` at step 3 feeds the `Edit` at step 4, and until today `_KEEP_INPUT` dropped the path so that read could never be kept.

The gap this recorded was the scorer's, not the segmenter's, and it is closed: `score.py` now runs the real fold and counts what is banked, so the trailing `git status` no longer reads as a second candidate. Passes.

input.text: There's no eval covering what the Welcome Book says about Udemy reimbursement. Find the fact in the book and add a case to cases.json asserting answer returns it — match the format of the other local-reference cases.

input.description: Find Udemy/reimbursement context in Welcome Book

input.command:
git add backend/concept_buddy_agent/eval/cases.json backend/concept_buddy_agent/eval/concept_buddy.evalset.json && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(eval): cover Udemy reimbursement fact from Welcome Book

Adds udemy_reimbursement_local case + regenerates evalset. Guards the
€100/year Udemy course reimbursement fact (benefits.md); no local-reference
case previously exercised it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <[REDACTED:email]>
EOF
)"
